environment.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/154.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 Edg/154.0.0.0

protocol.baseline: original db39ffa factory namespace, Blob construction and runWorkspaceWorker functions; fresh worker every call
protocol.cache: HTTP cache active with ETag revalidation; cold means new worker, not cleared browser/OS cache
protocol.current: actual src/workers/workspace-worker.mjs and src/application/worker-session.js; fresh/reused differentiated
protocol.download: local JSON only; no network submission or workspace storage
protocol.exclusions: fixture generation, explicit analysis-input profile setup, output hashing/equality, progress rendering, rAF probe setup/drain
protocol.memory: no claim: browser GC and per-worker peak memory are not controlled
protocol.order: rotate methods each round, reverse alternating rounds
protocol.prepareCopy: structuredClone of same fixture included for every method; IndexedDB loading not measured
protocol.profileAnalyzeCopy: same narrow production calculation snapshot and ArrayBuffer.slice copy, included for both direct and worker
protocol.responsiveness: rAF maximum observed gap, 16ms timer delay and optional Long Tasks; not a DOM/layout/application benchmark
protocol.timing: source copy + actual production worker construction/session + postMessage transfer + processing + complete response
protocol.verification: entire canonical output string equality, BigInt tagged exactly, array order preserved; each returned source byte compared to retained original

sources.serverPolicy: 127.0.0.1 only; explicit read-only asset allowlist; fixed in-memory asset snapshot; no uploads or data endpoints
